issues.problem: Persian digit glyphs at fs(190)=209px are wider than the 126px cell, so overflow:hidden slices the right side of the last digit (e.g. the digit ۳ is cut off with a vertical edge at x~1303 on f45, and ۳ ghosts on f38).
issues.suggestedFix: Widen DW (about 140-150) and keep the row centred (decimal glyph width and the transformOrigin recompute), or reduce FS slightly; re-check frames 20-60 for every digit 0-9.

issues.problem: Vazirmatn draws the decimal separator at display size as a huge slash dropping below the baseline, so the number reads like a fraction (۹۹/۹۸) and is visually heavier than the digits.
issues.suggestedFix: Scale the separator glyph down (smaller font-size, nudged to baseline) or use a smaller bold dot-like separator; keep width 70.

issues.problem: Says the percent sign is placed 'before the number' as Persian typography; it is actually logically after (۹۹٫۹۸٪) and only appears visually at the left. Also the title top was moved 96->80 without being documented.
issues.suggestedFix: Correct the comment wording and note the title offset.

notes: Checked: text and Persian digits correct, title mirrored right, number order/stagger kept with sound reasoning, timings/exports identical to original, no leftover Latin/Chinese, no letterSpacing, hold frames clean. Only the clipping is a real defect.
